name: Crag of the Everliving
summary: The Crag of the Everliving lies beneath a canopy of corrupted growth in the Wailing Caverns. Lord Pythas holds its central reaches, and an ancient being dwells in the heights above.

sections.title: A Corrupted Canopy
sections.body:
Twisted growth fills the Crag of the Everliving, fed by the Nightmare corrupting Naralex's sleep. Mossy platforms rise over winding paths where Deviate Shamblers prowl. These living plant hulks crowd the undergrowth.

Lord Pythas watches the crag's central reaches. Once a disciple of Naralex, he abandoned his druidic vows for the venomous rites of the Druids of the Fang.

sections.title: The Ancient Guardian
sections.body:
Verdan the Everliving gives the chamber its name. This colossal, primordial plant elemental dwells in the crag's upper heights, corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare gripping the cavern. No longer a peaceful guardian of nature, Verdan now forms a fearsome line of defense.

Beyond Verdan's towering form waits Lord Serpentis. He calls himself chief of the Fanglords and oversees the sect's descent into serpentine madness.

faq.q: Where does this area get its name?
faq.answer: The chamber takes its name from Verdan the Everliving, an ancient, colossal plant beast in the crag's highest terraces. Once nature's timeless vitality made manifest, he has fallen under the Nightmare's sway.

faq.q: Who controls this part of the caverns?
faq.answer: Lord Pythas presides over the crag. On higher ledges above him lurk Verdan the Everliving and Lord Serpentis, leader of the Druids of the Fang.

faq.q: What creatures are commonly found in the Crag of the Everliving?
faq.answer: Deviate Shamblers overrun the crag, alongside twisted serpents and fanatical Druids of the Fang. The Shamblers are plant horrors born from the corrupted springs.

faq.q: Why is plant life thriving so deep underground?
faq.answer: Naralex, a night elf druid, harnessed the underground springs to rejuvenate the Barrens. The Emerald Nightmare ensnared his ritual, driving wild growth rampant and twisting it into hostile, aberrant flora.

angles.text: For Cenarion druids, the Crag of the Everliving is a tragic lesson: the Nightmare has turned nature's vitality and elemental guardianship into lethal tools.
The crag's humid, dream-soaked soil and unnaturally lush underground air nourish rare roots and mushrooms.
